title: New business filings
description: Verified open-data feeds only: state entity formations (NY, PA, CO), liquor-license applications and approvals (NY, CO), and NYC new-restaurant inspections. Other states return an unsupported row and are not billed.

states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter codes. Verified open-data feeds: NY (DOS active corporations), PA (registered businesses), CO (business entities in Good Standing). New York, Pennsylvania, and Colorado are also accepted.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Which new-business signals to pull. entity_formation is the state entity feed (NY, PA, CO). liquor_license is NY State Liquor Authority pending applications and Colorado recently approved licenses. restaurant_inspection is NYC pre-permit initial inspections, the first health inspection of a new restaurant. A state with no feed for a trigger returns a free unsupported row. Default is entity_formation only.

counties.title: Counties
counties.description: Optional. Case-insensitive county names. NYC boroughs use county names (Kings for Brooklyn, New York for Manhattan, Richmond for Staten Island). A row with no county is omitted when this list is set, and the Colorado liquor feed has no county column. Leave empty for every county the feed publishes.

formedSince.title: Formed since
formedSince.description: Keep records whose trigger date is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD): formation date, liquor-license received or issue date, or inspection date. Default is 365 days before the run. Dates after the run date are dropped as bad data.

entityTypes.title: Entity types
entityTypes.description: Optional. Matched against the row type: entity type, liquor-license type (Restaurant, Tavern, Grocery Store), or inspection type. LLC matches a limited liability company. Leave empty for every type.

enrichWebsite.title: Enrich website and email
enrichWebsite.description: When true, accept a registry email and fetch a registry website if robots.txt allows it. Google web search is not used. The enrichment event is charged only when a website or email is found.

maxResults.title: Max entities
maxResults.description: Cap on entities pushed for this run, after dedupe. Default 50, maximum 200.

maxRequests.title: Max HTTP requests
maxRequests.description: Cap on requests, including robots.txt and a proxy retry. Default 12, maximum 40.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before each request after the first. Default 3, which covers the Crawl-delay of 1 published by the SODA feeds. The pause jitters up to 7 seconds when the delay is lower than that.

maxSpendUsd.title: Max spend (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Stop charging when the next business, enrichment, proxy, or CAPTCHA event would pass this amount. Default 5, maximum 100. Later entities are saved and are not billed.

maxProxyCostUsd.title: Max proxy spend (USD)
maxProxyCostUsd.description: Cap on proxy events alone. Default 0.50. A direct request is always tried first. Proxy is used only after a block, and only when this cap and maxSpendUsd both still have room.

allowCaptcha.title: Allow CAPTCHA solving
allowCaptcha.description: Default false. When false, a challenge after the proxy retry pushes a blocked row and exits without a solve charge. When true, a solve is attempted only if the proxy retry is still a challenge and maxSpendUsd covers the captcha event. This Actor does not ship a paid solver, so an unconfigured solve pushes blocked and is not billed.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Kept for the shared Actor contract. This Actor does not launch a browser.
